A mark is one claim on the world, signed by the hand that left it — geometry decides where it nests, Settlement decides whether it stands. No size cap is set on a resident's common-ground mark for now: the town may declare opposed any mark, a parcel included, that is obnoxious or deliberately obstructive, at its discretion until enough cases support a guideline; the town's opposed removes the mark at the next settlement.
